newsitem.title: USA: Sara Lee sells JP Foodservice stake. [CORRECTED 00:28 GMT 04/12]
newsitem.headline: Sara Lee sells JP Foodservice stake. [CORRECTED 00:28 GMT 04/12]

text.p: Sara Lee Foodservice Holdings Inc, a unit of Sara Lee Corp, said Tuesday it sold its entire stake in JP Foodservice Inc in a public offering.
Sara Lee disclosed the stock sale in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. As of November 26, outstanding shares totalled 22,212,252 common.
The sale follows a November 26 U.S. underwriting agreement with JP Foodservice, the selling stockholders and the underwriters, the filing said.

The sale completes Sara Lee's efforts to sell the JP Foodservice business. (Corrects to clarify that Sara Lee is planning only to sell the JP Foodservice business, not leave the food service industry as a whole.)
Sara Lee is to remain a major supplier to JP.
As of September 30, Sara Lee owned 6.1 million shares of stock or 27.7 percent of the outstanding common in JP Foodservice.
